title: Service Catalogue, Deterministic Pricing and Policies

extras.title: Quote and confirm a multi-line service basket
extras.guard: Validate every owned pet/service line and approved price/policy version; care traits are capabilities unless an approved surcharge exists
extras.effect: Compute combo once across visit count, cap at 10 percent, snapshot each line and allocate the one order fee without double counting
extras.alternative: Any changed selection invalidates stale quote; no guessed tax or automatic extra trait fee

extras.title: Split boarding into employee care shifts
extras.guard: Validate confirmed customer visits, approved care plan and each service duration
extras.effect: Split boarding shifts to at most 480 minutes; allocate integer service-net snapshots by duration/remainders while preserving customer total and combo visit count
extras.alternative: More than sixty shifts or missing operational facts requires review; shift time is not invented attendance

title: Care Instructions, Execution, Reports and Location

extras.title: Start, update and stop consented foreground travel sharing
extras.guard: Validate assigned visit, sharing consent, session version, fresh coordinate accuracy and bounded time window
extras.effect: Replace only the latest location, expose scoped ETA/map projection and expire/stop sharing; no historical travel trail retained
extras.alternative: Stale session, invalid coordinate, unsupported state or revoked assignment is rejected; real-device tracking acceptance remains separate

title: Employee Payroll, Salary Advances and Adjustments

extras.title: Request and decide a salary advance
extras.guard: Require active signed employment, approved monthly base, at most 50 percent and one approved advance/month
extras.effect: Submit/withdraw/reject/approve under month guard; retain rejection reason and agreed payroll offset
extras.alternative: Pending concurrent request or exhausted approved quota -> reject; no interest or fabricated statutory case

extras.title: Prepare source-based payroll and selected payslip print
extras.guard: Load signed terms, verified service credits and explicit attendance/KPI source decisions
extras.effect: Prepare immutable statement snapshots, agreed deductions/advances and identity reference; print selected statement
extras.alternative: Availability is not attendance; unresolved source/deduction remains pending rather than reduce salary

extras.title: Record a separate payroll adjustment
extras.guard: Require original statement reference, agreed reason/evidence and immutable source claim
extras.effect: Record supplement or agreed reconciliation separately; claim transfer reference exactly once
extras.alternative: Original paid statement stays unchanged; UNKNOWN transfer requires reconciliation

title: Product Catalogue, Cart, Orders and Returns
Suppliers, Goods Receipts and Stock Control
Public Sitter Profiles and Verified Ratings
Role Dashboards, Operational Reports and Audit
AI Feature Provenance, Training and Model Lifecycle

extras.title: Inspect training readiness
extras.guard: Read source joins and feature timestamps; exclude synthetic/stale/unverified labels
extras.effect: Return verified counts, shortages and blocked reasons without exporting real rows
extras.alternative: Readiness does not train, import, approve or assign

extras.title: Export verified training observations
extras.guard: Require explicit apply/private output and export secret; at least 200 observations/50 booking groups
extras.effect: HMAC opaque identifiers; write private point-in-time JSONL and source/hash manifest
extras.alternative: Too few valid groups or truncated source -> no export file

extras.title: Train and bundle a draft additive model
extras.guard: Validate verified satisfaction label, feature availability and grouped chronological split
extras.effect: Fit five nonnegative weights; retain baseline/test MAE and produce DRAFT JSON/evidence; bundle exact hashes
extras.alternative: Synthetic/OSRM/heuristic labels or temporal leakage -> reject; no automatic approval

extras.title: Import draft artifact and evidence
extras.guard: Validate exact JSON shape, DRAFT state, temporal evidence, hashes and immutable version
extras.effect: Persist SitterRankModel plus private original artifact/evidence for later review
extras.alternative: Same version/different bytes or evidence mismatch -> conflict

extras.title: Approve and activate a reviewed model
extras.guard: Operational gate: independent source/evaluation review. API verifies current ADMIN, reviewReference, review version, improved MAE and artifact/evidence integrity
extras.effect: Transaction records review decision and activation guard; only an approved valid model is selected
extras.alternative: A reviewReference string does not itself prove reviewer independence; importer/reviewer separation is a process gate, not a demonstrated API rejection. Stale version -> conflict

extras.title: Retire model and use rule fallback
extras.guard: Validate current model review version or runtime artifact gate
extras.effect: Retire immutable model version or retain explainable 30/25/20/15/10 policy when model is unusable
extras.alternative: No model or bad artifact never changes prices, eligibility or money

extras.title: Check vet-escort route and appointment feasibility
extras.guard: Require confirmed clinic, appointment, waiting budget and return scope; road route and buffered slot must cover the full plan
extras.effect: Compare outward/return ETA, appointment and waiting against requested slot; rank only feasible candidates
extras.alternative: Route unavailable, over review cap or infeasible appointment returns explicit review/conflict; specialized MATCH checkout still requires Staff scope review

extras.title: Advise an operational employee invitation shortlist
extras.guard: Start with the authoritative eligible employee IDs; validate optional model, source statistics and road insertion feasibility
extras.effect: Reorder candidate IDs with captured decision-time features; retain unscored eligible IDs for authoritative invitation checks
extras.alternative: Partial routing/statistics failure cannot disqualify an otherwise eligible employee or mutate money; final acceptance rechecks occupancy

extras.title: Track and edit an owned pending application
extras.guard: Bind application to authenticated owner/current verified legacy contact; check PENDING version
extras.effect: Read status directly without second OTP; edit only allowed fields with idempotent optimistic update
extras.alternative: Admin review racing owner edit -> one guarded commit; processed application is read-only

extras.title: Issue, sign and activate an employment document
extras.guard: Validate actual particulars, canonical gender, contract terms and document/application version
extras.effect: DRAFT -> ISSUED -> SIGNED -> ACTIVATED; retain encrypted immutable terms/hash and activate employment atomically
extras.alternative: Unsigned invalid legacy gender blocks issue/sign; signed history cannot be rewritten

extras.title: Prefill and print a versioned contract
extras.guard: Authorize private application/contract; preserve saved terms over optional suggestions
extras.effect: Allowlist verified prefill and render the selected document revision/reference for print
extras.alternative: Missing original identity/schedule is reported; do not guess or mass-backfill

title: Legacy Earnings, Holds and Settlement Reconciliation

extras.title: Reserve and submit legacy weekly settlement
extras.guard: Read eligible available legacy earnings and cross-week booking quota under transaction guards
extras.effect: Reserve earning slices and weekly claims; persist submitted request plus command/event atomically
extras.alternative: Open case/refund, missing tax/payment or conflicting reservation -> hold/conflict

extras.title: Approve, reject or withdraw settlement
extras.guard: Authorize actor/current request version and approved financial policy
extras.effect: Approve immutable amount or release reservation on eligible rejection/withdrawal with audited reason
extras.alternative: Approved onward cannot be silently withdrawn; employee wages use payroll instead

extras.title: Record transfer and reconcile uncertain result
extras.guard: Validate reserved request, immutable amount, independent transfer evidence and unique bank reference
extras.effect: PAID only for confirmed matching transfer; UNKNOWN or amount mismatch stays reconciliation state
extras.alternative: Replayed acknowledgement cannot double-pay or release/reuse bank reference

extras.title: Apply and release a case or refund money hold
extras.guard: Use authoritative booking/earning guard and case/refund source reference
extras.effect: Add audited financial lock; release only after final explicit authorized conclusion
extras.alternative: After payout create approved adjustment; never automatic clawback

title: Background Jobs and Durable Application Mail

extras.title: Publish visit reminders
extras.guard: Bound eligible due visits and deduplicate reminder event/recipient
extras.effect: Publish one reminder through durable notification/provider ports
extras.alternative: This job export is not proof of runtime startup or inbox acceptance

extras.title: Dispatch invitations and expire unanswered offers
extras.guard: Require composed enabled worker, current booking/payment/care plan and eligible employee
extras.effect: Bound queue pass; recheck eligibility/occupancy; persist expiring invitation and next-candidate event
extras.alternative: No eligible employee or stale visit -> Staff attention; recommendation never assigns directly

extras.title: Reconcile payment reminders and overdue state
extras.guard: Check due intent/current provider result before payment/overdue decision
extras.effect: Record deduplicated reminder/reconciliation; retain unknown provider result for Staff
extras.alternative: No automatic debt collection or expired-order revival

extras.title: Expire unpaid or uncollected product holds
extras.guard: Design: identify expired current-state order under stock/version guard
extras.effect: Design: cancel once and release only its held quantities; preserve attributable refusal rule
extras.alternative: Full deadline scheduler integration still needs verification; prepaid timeout is not customer refusal

extras.title: Recompute approved customer tier
extras.guard: Design requires an approved tier threshold/discount source and verified paid annual spend
extras.effect: Design: versioned tier assessment from eligible service/product/counter receipts
extras.alternative: No approved current tier source means no invented discount, points or fake customer rank

extras.title: Plan a feasible sitter visit order
extras.guard: Validate current authorized visits, registered work windows, road matrix and workload bounds
extras.effect: Design/export: bounded route order recommendation that preserves authoritative assignments
extras.alternative: OSRM estimate is not live traffic or a training satisfaction label

extras.title: Flag late check-in and operational attention
extras.guard: Evaluate current visit/time against approved policy under bounded repeated sweep
extras.effect: Design/export: deduplicated Staff notice and Needs action escalation
extras.alternative: Do not charge arbitrary late fees or mark an unobserved visit completed

extras.title: Retry durable application-status email
extras.guard: Lease a due encrypted recipient snapshot; check bounded attempts and stable provider operation identity
extras.effect: Send configured mail; record accepted/failure and next retry without rolling back saved application
extras.alternative: Provider acceptance is not inbox delivery; preserve record after exhausted attempts

title: Map, Private Media and Public Contact Boundaries

extras.title: Search and confirm a service-address map point
extras.guard: Authenticate same-origin map proxy; validate search/resolve input and supported coverage
extras.effect: Resolve provider result; explicit user pin confirmation saves private location/GeoJSON/version
extras.alternative: Missing provider or unsupported/ambiguous point remains explicit; do not expose provider key

extras.title: Read road ETA and bounded route matrix
extras.guard: Validate provider, origin/points, timeout, response bounds and exact cache identity
extras.effect: Use Vietmap or OSRM road ETA plus policy buffers; store 15-minute matrix edges
extras.alternative: No straight-line fabricated ETA, live-traffic guarantee or label substitution

extras.title: Upload and read private care or applicant evidence
extras.guard: Validate session/role, media ownership/type, encoded size, pixels and quota
extras.effect: Normalize bounded image; store private R2 reference and authorize each resource read
extras.alternative: Wrong owner/type/invalid image or unavailable provider -> reject; no public application URL

extras.title: Replace an avatar or product photo
extras.guard: Validate entity ownership or Admin permission, image bounds and current media version
extras.effect: Normalize bounded avatar/product bytes in MongoDB; update version/hash/tombstone transactionally
extras.alternative: Profile/product snapshot history and owner guards survive replacement/removal

extras.title: Send a public contact enquiry
extras.guard: Validate bounded enquiry and server-configured inbox/provider; apply rate limits
extras.effect: Submit through backend contact-delivery port; return safe accepted/unavailable result
extras.alternative: A configured adapter does not prove inbox receipt; do not expose inbox credentials

extras.title: Install and recover the web application shell
extras.guard: Require supported browser/HTTPS and current manifest/service-worker asset version
extras.effect: Cache only approved application-shell assets; retain online/offline status and request retry feedback
extras.alternative: No offline financial command success, cached private API data or background GPS guarantee is inferred; device acceptance remains pending
